Analysts cited strong demand, improving margins and capacity expansion, with target prices implying upside of up to 35%.

title: Global Market: HSBC H1 profit jumps 23%, beats estimates on strong wealth, interest income

The banking giant also announced a $1 billion share buyback and declared a second interim dividend of $0.10 per share, underscoring its focus on rewarding shareholders.

title: Global Market: South Korean shares slip nearly 2% as AI spending worries overshadow softer inflation
description: South Korean shares fell nearly 2% on Tuesday as renewed concerns over AI-related spending and heavy selling in semiconductor stocks overshadowed softer-than-expected inflation. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix led losses, while easing consumer prices and foreign investor buying failed to lift overall market sentiment.

title: Dabur shares drop 3% after FSSAI bars FMCG major from selling products with '100%' guarantee claims
description: Dabur India shares fell nearly 3% after the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) barred the FMCG company from selling certain food products carrying misleading "100%" claims. The regulator said labels such as "100% Natural" and "100% Pure" violate the Food Safety and Standards (Advertising and Claims) Regulations, 2018, as they are ambiguous, unverifiable and likely to mislead consumers.

title: Thangamayil share selloff continues: Stock drops 5% despite Rs 344 crore sales in first 3 days of August
description: Thangamayil Jewellery shares fell significantly despite robust August sales figures. The company reported strong sales during the auspicious Aadi Perukku festival. However, weak guidance and market uncertainties impacted investor sentiment negatively. Customers postponed purchases due to gold price expectations and geopolitical concerns. The company anticipates demand recovery in the latter half of the fiscal year.

title: KEI Industries shares surge 7% after Q1FY27 profit jumps 40%, revenue rises 23%

title: Global Market: Japan's Nikkei slips as intervention fears weigh; Toyota earnings in focus

The yen traded around 157.5 per dollar after Japan and the US coordinated intervention to support the currency, raising concerns for exporters.

title: US Stock Market: Treasury sees higher Q3 borrowing needs as cash flow outlook weakens
description: The US Treasury anticipates borrowing $739 billion in the third quarter. This borrowing estimate reflects lower cash flows and a stronger opening balance. For the fourth quarter, the department projects borrowing of $628 billion. The Treasury borrowed $190 billion in the second quarter, ending June with $919 billion. Investors await debt issuance plans amid market volatility and inflation concerns.
